# College of Agriculture & Natural Resources (CANR) - Michigan State University

> CANR at Michigan State University advances agricultural innovation, research, and extension through academic programs, AgBioResearch initiatives, and community outreach across Michigan and globally.

The College of Agriculture & Natural Resources is Michigan State University's hub for agricultural education, food systems research, and extension services. CANR combines academic excellence with practical application through MSU Extension, AgBioResearch, and the World Agriculture Center to address challenges in food production, environmental sustainability, and natural resource management.

## Core Programs & Initiatives

- [College of Agriculture & Natural Resources](https://www.canr.msu.edu): MSU CANR homepage with research, extension, and agricultural innovation.
- [About CANR](https://www.canr.msu.edu/about): CANR overview covering history, programs, research, and extension.
- [MSU Extension](https://www.canr.msu.edu/outreach): MSU Extension outreach, 4-H, and community resources.
- [AgBioResearch](https://www.canr.msu.edu/research): MSU AgBioResearch initiatives for food systems and environment.
- [World Agriculture Center](https://www.canr.msu.edu/global): WorldAg Center global engagement for food, agriculture, resources.

## Research & Innovation

- [MSU Turf: A Legacy of World-Class Grass Management](https://www.canr.msu.edu/news/msu-turf-a-legacy-of-world-class-grass-management): MSU turfgrass research collaboration with FIFA for 2026 World Cup.
- [MSU Education, Research Helping Grow Mass Timber Building Industry](https://www.canr.msu.edu/news/msu-education-research-helping-grow-mass-timber-building-industry-in-michigan-and-beyond): MassTimber@MSU sustainable construction education and research.
- [MSU, Glanbia Collaboration Advances Environmental Sustainability](https://www.canr.msu.edu/news/msu-glanbia-collaboration-advances-environmental-sustainability-at-michigan-dairy-processing-facility): MSU-Glanbia dairy processing facility sustainability partnership.
- [How MSU, M-AAA Helped Build a National Model for Laying Hen Research](https://www.canr.msu.edu/news/how-msu-m-aaa-helped-build-a-national-model-for-laying-hen-research): MSU-M-AAA laying hen research facility and housing innovation.
- [New MSU Research Introduces Novel Method for Nitrous Oxide Emissions](https://www.canr.msu.edu/news/new-msu-research-introduces-novel-method-to-improve-prediction-of-us-cropland-nitrous-oxide-emissions): MSU research on predicting cropland greenhouse gas emissions.
